verdict.rationale: Luma's Modify Video V2 is documented as reshaping existing footage: it can swap the wall, the world, or the wardrobe while lighting and performance are preserved, at up to 20 seconds in 1080p. Related claims describe turning people into new characters while keeping their performance and adapting products without reshoots, which together cover element-level replacement and restyling. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how a specific element is targeted (e.g. masking or selection), API-level documentation of the modify endpoint, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the rest of the frame stays intact.
